name: Hadrian’s Wall Path
description: The Hadrian’s Wall Path is an iconic 84-mile (135 km) National Trail spanning coast-to-coast across Northern England from Wallsend in Newcastle upon Tyne to Bowness-on-Solway in Cumbria. Following the line of Emperor Hadrian's 2nd-century Roman frontier, it is the only National Trail built along an entire UNESCO World Heritage Site.
